narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in southeastern Pennsylvania on the afternoon of July 7. Rainfall totals were as high as 2.0 to 3.5 inches.
ev: PA Route 12 became impassable due to flooding between PA Route 61 and Business US Route 222 in Muhlenberg Township.

Widespread roadway flooding occurred in West Whiteland Township with many roads becoming impassable. Numerous vehicles were trapped in flood waters, with some motorists needing assistance on Spackmans Lane and on Whitford Road.
lsr: PA-12 at US-222 Business 5th Street flooded both ways spotted on PennDOT traffic camera. One disabled vehicle.
Water assist for flooded vehicle near Spackmans Ln.
Water assist for flooded vehicle on S Whitford Rd on Quarry Ln.
